preference_anchors.anchor: Audits remain read-only and never modify the target Skill.
Findings include severity, evidence, impact, repair target, and verification hint.
Instruction Contract is scored with sentence-level evidence.
Runtime, install, gate, eval, and downstream surfaces are included in scope evidence.
Strong Skills are used as mechanism benchmarks, not wording templates.
Old active Skill names are treated as runtime residue unless explicitly historical.

Default audits produce a formal verdict, JSON report, validator PASS output, current-file evidence checks for P0/P1 findings, and a concise summary artifact with per-finding evidence, impact, repair target, and verification hint in one run.
Light scans are allowed only when explicitly requested as non-final and do not issue fit, conditional, unfit, or blocked verdicts.
Default audits choose report artifact paths automatically under docs/tmp for discoverability; missing or unwritable artifact parents fall back to /tmp instead of requiring a second user request.
Light scans use unranked candidate risks only and do not emit P0/P1/P2/P3 severity labels.
P0/P1 findings survive claim decomposition, current-file evidence verification, direct refutation checks, and severity calibration before entering the final report.
Existing audit artifacts are classified before review; transcript artifacts are rejected as reports and used only as leads for a fresh formal audit.
Default formal audits produce and validate a confirmed alignment artifact before any team-readiness verdict, scorecard, severity finding, or report validator claim.
Formal findings reference confirmed gap ids from the alignment baseline; inferred, self-declared, unknown, or historical claims cannot be treated as supported current capability evidence.

sample_matrix.prompt: Audit an existing Skill for team-use readiness and produce a formal JSON report, Markdown summary, validator output, and repair handoff.
sample_matrix.sample_out_boundary: Proves the default formal-audit artifact path for a concrete Skill; it does not prove readiness for untested Skill classes.

sample_matrix.prompt: Do a quick, non-final light scan of an existing Skill and return only candidate risks and missing evidence.
sample_matrix.sample_out_boundary: Proves the explicit light-scan path avoids final verdicts and severity labels; it does not prove formal report quality.

sample_matrix.prompt: Classify an existing audit artifact before trusting it, reject transcripts as formal reports, and use them only as leads for a fresh audit.
sample_matrix.sample_out_boundary: Proves artifact classification and transcript distrust; it does not prove the transcript claims are true.

sample_matrix.prompt: Validate a skill-quality-audit alignment that is awaiting user confirmation but already contains a readiness verdict, severity finding, or report validator PASS claim.
sample_matrix.sample_out_boundary: Proves pre-confirmation formal claims fail closed; it does not prove the semantic quality of a confirmed audit.

sample_matrix.prompt: Review a normal code file or implementation plan that is not a Skill package and decide whether skill-quality-audit should stay inactive.
sample_matrix.sample_out_boundary: Proves a near-miss routing boundary; it does not prove all non-Skill review requests are excluded.

sample_matrix.prompt: Grade a generic Skill review against the same readiness anchors without using skill-quality-audit-specific workflow or validators.
sample_matrix.sample_out_boundary: Proves comparative baseline measurement exists; it does not prove with_skill superiority without delta review.

sample_matrix.prompt: Validate a skill-quality-audit report whose P1 evidence_checks cite a stale path:line snippet.
sample_matrix.sample_out_boundary: Proves stale evidence rejection for audit reports; it does not prove all empirical samples are fresh.

sample_matrix.prompt: Validate a formal report where a P1 finding lacks repair target, verification hint, or summary handoff coverage.
sample_matrix.sample_out_boundary: Proves missing repair handoff is rejected; it does not judge the semantic quality of the proposed repair.

sample_matrix.prompt: Validate a formal report where a P0/P1 finding lacks supported claim_review, severity_calibration, or current evidence checks.
sample_matrix.sample_out_boundary: Proves P0/P1 findings fail closed when claim review is missing or unsupported; it does not prove lower-severity triage quality.

sample_matrix.prompt: Use a completed audit report to identify the next repair files and verification commands without replaying the whole audit.
sample_matrix.sample_out_boundary: Proves a separate repair window can consume the handoff; it does not prove the repair itself was implemented.

expectations: Flags target modification authority as a runtime safety defect.
Returns repair targets for a separate implementation window.
Identifies vague action, broad object, hidden condition, and missing verification criteria.
Caps the verdict below fit when Instruction Contract is weak.

evals.prompt: Audit a Skill replacement where old runtime, install, test, and eval paths still mention the retired Skill name.
expectations: Classifies active old-name references as residue.
Separates active consumers from historical snapshots.

evals.prompt: Compare a target Skill with brainstorming without copying its structure.
expectations: Extracts mechanism lessons such as hard gates, terminal states, and confirmation points.
Rejects section-copying as the quality target.

evals.prompt: Audit shared/skills/skill-quality-audit/evals/fixtures/target-skills/good-skill for team-use readiness. Do not edit the target Skill.
expectations: Produces a confirmed alignment artifact before the formal verdict.
Does not emit a formal verdict, scorecard, severity finding, or report validator PASS claim before alignment confirmation.
Produces a formal verdict in the same run when the target capability is confirmed by the user request or repository contract.
Chooses report artifact paths automatically when the user does not provide them.
Chooses alignment artifact paths automatically when the user does not provide them.
Produces a machine-readable JSON report before or with the formal verdict.
Includes capability_baseline_ref, confirmed_target_capability_ids, and confirmed_gap_refs in the report.
Includes evidence_checks for every P0/P1 finding so the validator can verify the current cited file line.
Includes claim_review and severity_calibration for every P0/P1 finding.
Runs both the skill audit alignment validator and report validator, then includes both PASS outputs in the final handoff.
Keeps any Markdown response as a summary, not the artifact of record.
Markdown summary and chat handoff are not title-only; each P0/P1 finding includes full path:line evidence, impact, repair target, and verification hint.
Does not include empty optional finding fields such as empty claim_review or severity_calibration objects.

evals.prompt: Audit shared/skills/skill-quality-audit/evals/fixtures/target-skills/good-skill for team-use readiness. First produce a confirmed alignment artifact and do not emit a verdict, scorecard, severity finding, or report validator PASS claim before alignment validation.
expectations: Produces a skill-audit-alignment JSON artifact before the formal report.
Validates the alignment artifact before any readiness verdict.
Separates target capability claims from evidence-backed current capability profile.

evals.prompt: Audit a new or unclear Skill whose target capability is mostly inferred from its own description. Do not treat the inferred target as G1-confirmed team-readiness scope; ask for confirmation or stop before formal audit.
expectations: Does not use model-inferred or self-declared target capability as G1 confirmed scope.
Stops at G2/G3 confirmation before formal readiness verdict when target capability is unclear.
Keeps assumptions or unknowns out of supported current capability evidence.

evals.prompt: Validate that every formal finding in a skill-quality-audit report references confirmed gap ids from a confirmed alignment baseline.
expectations: Requires capability_baseline_ref and confirmed_target_capability_ids in the report.
Requires each finding to include confirmed_gap_refs.
Rejects a finding whose confirmed gap id is missing from the alignment artifact.

evals.prompt: Do a quick, non-final light scan of shared/skills/skill-quality-audit/evals/fixtures/target-skills/unclear-instruction-skill for likely issues.
expectations: Labels the result non-final.
Uses unranked candidate risks instead of severity labels P0/P1/P2/P3.
Does not issue a formal fit, conditional, unfit, or blocked verdict.
Does not ask the user for report paths or a second request.

evals.prompt: Review whether shared/skills/skill-quality-audit/evals/fixtures/artifacts/overview-transcript.md is a valid skill-quality-audit result and whether its claims should be trusted.
expectations: Classifies the input artifact before judging content.
Rejects transcript artifacts as formal reports.
Treats transcript content only as leads for a fresh formal audit.
Does not accept high-priority claims from the transcript without current path:line evidence and claim review.
